newsitem.title: FRANCE: Hong Kong activist warns against business with China.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong activist warns against business with China.

text.p: Hong Kong Democratic Party leader Martin Lee warned Europe on Tuesday against turning a blind eye to possible future Chinese human rights violations in Hong Kong because of a desire to do business with Beijing.

"Every country today sees China as a big pie with 1.2 billion inhabitants. But to get a slice of the pie, one does not have to swallow everything, on the contrary," Lee told a news conference dutring a visit to the Council of Europe.
"While the whole world evolves towards democracy and the respect of human rights, will China be accepted as the world's sole exception?" he asked.
He singled out threats against freedom of the press once Hong Kong reverted to Chinese rule later this year.
"If you are a businessman, you need precise and reliable economic information. If you don't have it, then your investments will be at risk," he said.
Lee, who is touring European capitals, also said he hoped the end of British rule would not mean a reversion to corruption.
